{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for: completed orders, loyal segment, and exclude QA orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Final check: confirm all conditions are met
assert len(filtered_df) > 0, "No loyal completed orders after filtering"
assert filtered_df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum() == 0, "NaN values in revenue after cleaning"

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders (excluding QA): {len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD): {mean_revenue}")"}
